chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, and Ali ibn Ibraheem, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Harun ibn Mansur al-Abdi, from Abu al-Ward, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to Fatima (peace be upon her) regarding the dream she saw: 'Say: I seek Refuge by what the Proximate Angels of Allah, and His Sent Prophets, and His Righteous Servants seek Refuge with, from the evil of what I have seen in this night of mine, that any harm or anything I dislike from it should befall me. Then turn towards your left three times.'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication and action to ward off evil seen in a dream according to Shia tradition?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this hadith highlights the spiritual authority of Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) as the recipient of direct prophetic instruction regarding dream interpretation and protection. The specific formula invokes the collective refuge of the highest ranks of creation—Proximate Angels, Sent Prophets, and Righteous Servants—emphasizing a hierarchical spiritual defense against unseen evils. The ritual of turning to the left three times serves as a physical manifestation of turning away from the source of the dream's disturbance, a practice deeply rooted in Shia devotional tradition.
